name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-backend
description: Registry manifest for the desktop app's backend closure: pinned published @deepseek-ai/dsh with its dependency tree. scripts/build-desktop-backend.mjs installs this with npm ci narrowed to one target platform/architecture (win32 or darwin); the committed package-lock.json is what makes staging reproducible. NOT a pnpm workspace member (apps/* is one level): linkWorkspacePackages would otherwise swap the registry pin for the local apps/cli source.
